name: Phil Clunies-Ross
story: Phil Clunies-Ross presented a lightning talk at FOSS4G Auckland in November 2025 about Delinify, a reporting tool he had recently built using open-source software and AI. The presentation was one example of practitioners experimenting with AI-assisted spatial reporting by the end of 2025.
